summary: Tested mobile back button fix and admin strain edit functionality. Both user-reported issues verified as FIXED: 1) Mobile back button '← BACK' is now visible and working on mobile viewport (390x844), 2) Admin strain edit correctly preserves image_url and coa_url fields when updating other fields (exclude_unset=True fix confirmed working).
passed_tests: ✅ Backend: Admin login with correct password (firegold2026) returns token
✅ Backend: Admin login with wrong password returns 401
✅ Backend: PUT /api/strains/{id} preserves image_url when not included in payload (exclude_unset=True fix)
✅ Backend: PUT /api/strains/{id} preserves coa_url when not included in payload
✅ Backend: PUT /api/strains/{id} requires admin authentication (401 without token)
✅ Backend: PUT /api/strains/{id} returns 404 for non-existent strain
✅ Backend: User can register and access strains with user token
✅ Frontend Mobile: Strain detail modal shows sticky header bar with '← BACK' and strain name
✅ Frontend Mobile: Mobile back button visible on 390x844 viewport
✅ Frontend Mobile: Clicking back button closes modal (no refresh needed!)
✅ Frontend Mobile: Back button remains visible after scrolling inside modal (sticky header)
✅ Frontend Mobile: Can re-open and close multiple strain modals without page refresh
✅ Frontend Mobile: Desktop close button (X) hidden on mobile viewport
✅ Frontend Admin: Edit button visible on Images tab for all strains
✅ Frontend Admin: Edit strain modal opens with pre-filled form fields
✅ Frontend Admin: Changing THC percentage and saving shows success toast 'Strain updated'
✅ Frontend Admin: Edit persists - refreshed admin panel shows updated value

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all mobile back button and admin edit features working)

seed_data_creation: Used existing Jealousy strain. Created test users with email pattern mobiletest*@example.com and straintest*@example.com during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both user-reported bugs are FIXED: 1) Mobile back button ('← BACK') now appears as a sticky header bar on mobile viewports (md:hidden class) at top of strain detail modal, containing ArrowLeft icon + 'Back' text on left and strain name on right. The desktop X close button uses 'hidden md:flex' to hide on mobile. 2) Admin strain edit PUT endpoint uses exclude_unset=True to preserve image_url and coa_url when these fields are not included in the update payload. Frontend saveEditStrain function in App.js line 2135 calls PUT /api/strains/{id} and only sends editable fields (strain_name, type, thc_percentage, etc.) without image_url, which is correctly preserved by the backend.
